concurrency.spawn_rule: Spawn only when ownership is independent, acceptance is observable, and coordination cost is lower than time saved.

T1.selection: cheapest live canary-proven compatible candidate from gpt-6-luna, deepseek-flash, or gemini-3.1-flash-lite

T2.purpose: cross-file integration, ambiguous bugs, and standard review
T2.selection: best value from current task-relevant mini-benchmark; prefer gpt-5.6-luna or deepseek-v4-pro when the harness supports the endpoint

T3.purpose: final review or verified hard blocker
T3.selection: gpt-5.6-sol, only after evidence and only when the cheaper route is insufficient
